versions.description_html:
Real-time analytics sounds like a job for a data engineer, but the idea underneath it is simple. Instead of waiting for tomorrow morning's report, your systems react to what's happening right now.

In this episode of Simply Explained you will learn:
  • Why Real-Time Analytics Sounds Harder Than It Is
  • What Real-Time Actually Means Here
  • The Building Blocks You'll See in Every Fabric Real-Time Setup
  • How One Reading Travels From a Sensor to Your Screen
  • Where This Shows Up in Real Work
  • How It Fits With Power BI, Microsoft 365, and Azure
  • The Mistakes Beginners Make
  • The Honest Limits and the Cost Conversation
  • How to Start Without Overwhelming Yourself
  • A Quick Recap and a Question for You

Simply Explained by M365.FM breaks down Microsoft 365, Azure and modern IT topics in clear, jargon-free language. Hosted by Mirko Peters.
